function.name: free_dce
function.description: This function is used to free a DCE (Device Context Entry). It first locks the user, checks if the DCE is valid and if the count is zero, it releases the DCE and removes it from the list. If the DCE's window handle matches the provided handle, it releases the DCE. It then checks for cache DCEs. If the window handle is valid, it iterates through the DCE list and releases any DCEs that match the window handle and have the cache flag set. It then unlocks the user. If a DCE was marked for freeing, it sets the DCE's device context to NULL, deletes the DCE's object application, and frees the DCE.

parameters.name: dce
parameters.description: A pointer to the DCE to be freed

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: A handle to the window associated with the DCE

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the redraw request was successful or not

function.name: get_update_flags
function.description: This function retrieves update flags for a given window and its child window, if any. It communicates with a server to get the update region, and updates the flags and child window handle accordingly.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window for which update flags are to be retrieved

parameters.name: child
parameters.description: Pointer to a handle to the child window. This will be updated with the handle to the child window returned from the server.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Pointer to the update flags. This will be updated with the flags returned from the server.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the server call was successful or not

function.name: send_ncpaint
function.description: This function is used to send a non-client area paint message. It checks if the update region overlaps with the non-client area, and if it does, it creates a new region that excludes the client area. If the update region contains the complete non-client area, it deletes the original region and sets the whole region to 1. It then checks if the non-client area needs to be updated and sends a WM_NCPAINT message if necessary.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window that the function operates on.

parameters.name: child
parameters.description: Pointer to a handle to the child window. If this parameter is not NULL, the function operates on the child window instead of the window specified by hwnd.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Pointer to a set of flags that specify how the function operates. For example, if the UPDATE_NONCLIENT flag is set, the function sends a WM_NCPAINT message.

function.return_type: HRGN. It represents the handle to the region that needs to be updated. If the whole region is 1, it means that the entire non-client area needs to be updated.

function.name: send_erase
function.description: This function determines whether a window needs to be erased and performs the erasing if necessary. It also handles the retrieval and release of the device context for the window.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags that specify the erasing and updating options.

parameters.name: client_rgn
parameters.description: Handle to the region within the window.

parameters.name: clip_rect
parameters.description: Pointer to a RECT structure that specifies the clipping rectangle.

parameters.name: hdc_ret
parameters.description: Pointer to a HDC that receives the device context of the window.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the window needs to be erased or not.

function.name: move_window_bits
function.description: This function moves the bits of a window. It first checks if the source and destination rectangles are not the same. If they are not, it gets the update region of the window, gets the device context of the window, and then copies the bits from the source rectangle to the destination rectangle.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window.

parameters.name: rects
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure containing the rectangles of the window.

parameters.name: valid_rects
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of rectangles that are valid for the window.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: move_window_bits_surface
function.description: This function moves the bits of a window surface from one rectangle to another. It first gets the update region of the window, then locks the old surface, gets the color of the old surface, sets the bits to the device, unlocks the old surface, and finally releases the device context.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window

parameters.name: window_rect
parameters.description: Pointer to the rectangle of the window

parameters.name: old_surface
parameters.description: Pointer to the old surface of the window

parameters.name: old_visible_rect
parameters.description: Pointer to the old visible rectangle of the window

parameters.name: valid_rects
parameters.description: Pointer to the valid rectangles of the window

function.return_type: void

function.name: NtUserBeginPaint
function.description: This function begins the painting process for a specified window. It hides the caret, sends non-client area paint message, erases the background if necessary, and prepares the paint structure.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window that is to be repainted.

parameters.name: ps
parameters.description: Pointer to a PAINTSTRUCT structure that will receive painting information.

function.return_type: HDC, represents the handle to the device context for the specified window. If the function fails, the return value is zero.

function.name: NtUserEndPaint
function.description: This function ends a painting session that was previously started by a call to the BeginPaint function.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: A handle to the window that is to be repainted.

parameters.name: ps
parameters.description: A pointer to a PAINTSTRUCT structure that was filled by the BeginPaint function.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function succeeds, or FALSE otherwise.

function.name: erase_now
function.description: This function erases a specified window and potentially its child windows based on the provided flags. It loops through each child window, updating and erasing as necessary until there are no more children or the flags indicate no further action is needed.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window to be erased

parameters.name: rdw_flags
parameters.description: Flags that specify how the window is to be erased

function.return_type: void, meaning this function does not return a value

function.name: update_now
function.description: This function updates a window and its child windows based on the specified flags. It handles special cases for the desktop window and loops through child windows to repaint them as necessary.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window that needs to be updated

parameters.name: rdw_flags
parameters.description: Flags that specify how the window is to be updated

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: NtUserRedrawWindow
function.description: This function redraws the specified window or region within a window. It also processes any pending expose events before painting.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window to be redrawn.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: Pointer to a RECT structure that contains the coordinates of the rectangle to be redrawn. If this parameter is NULL, the entire client area is redrawn.

parameters.name: hrgn
parameters.description: Handle to the region to be redrawn. This parameter is ignored if the rect parameter is non-NULL.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Specifies the redraw options. It can be a combination of the RedrawWindow function flags.

function.return_type: BOOL. Returns TRUE if the function succeeds, or FALSE otherwise.

function.name: NtUserValidateRect
function.description: This function validates a rectangle in a window. If the window handle is null, it invalidates and redraws all children of the window.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window that contains the rectangle to be validated.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: Pointer to a RECT structure that contains the logical coordinates of the rectangle to be validated.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the window was successfully redrawn or not.

function.name: NtUserValidateRgn
function.description: This function validates a region in a window. If the window handle is invalid, it sets the last error to ERROR_INVALID_WINDOW_HANDLE and returns FALSE. Otherwise, it redraws the window and returns the result of the redraw operation.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: This is a handle to the window that contains the region to be validated.

parameters.name: hrgn
parameters.description: This is a handle to the region within the window to be validated.

function.return_type: BOOL. This represents whether the function was successful in validating the region. It returns FALSE if the window handle is invalid, otherwise it returns the result of the redraw operation.

function.name: NtUserGetUpdateRgn
function.description: This function gets the update region of a window, optionally erases the background, and then combines the update region with the specified region.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window whose update region is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: hrgn
parameters.description: Handle to the region to be combined with the update region.

parameters.name: erase
parameters.description: Specifies whether the background within the update region is to be erased.

function.return_type: INT, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, the return value is nonzero. If the function fails, the return value is zero.

function.name: NtUserGetUpdateRect
function.description: This function retrieves the update region of a window, transforms the coordinates of the region, and determines whether the region needs to be erased.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window whose update region is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: Pointer to a RECT structure that receives the coordinates of the update region.

parameters.name: erase
parameters.description: Specifies whether the update region should be erased.

function.return_type: BOOL. Returns TRUE if the function successfully retrieves the update region and determines whether it needs to be erased; otherwise, it returns FALSE.

function.name: NtUserExcludeUpdateRgn
function.description: This function excludes the update region of a window from the current clipping region of a specified device context.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window whose update region is to be excluded.

function.return_type: INT, represents the complexity of the resulting region if the function succeeds, or an error code if the function fails.

function.name: NtUserInvalidateRgn
function.description: This function invalidates the region of a window, causing the window to be redrawn. If the 'erase' parameter is true, the function also erases the background.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window whose region is to be invalidated.

parameters.name: hrgn
parameters.description: Handle to the region to be invalidated. If this parameter is NULL, the entire window is invalidated.

parameters.name: erase
parameters.description: Specifies whether the background within the update region is to be erased when the update region is processed.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the function was successful or not. Returns FALSE if the window handle is invalid, otherwise returns the result of NtUserRedrawWindow function.

function.name: NtUserInvalidateRect
function.description: This function invalidates the rectangle area of a window and adds it to the window's update region. The update region represents the portion of the window's client area that must be redrawn.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window whose update region has changed.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: Pointer to a RECT structure that contains the client coordinates of the rectangle to be added to the update region.

parameters.name: erase
parameters.description: Specifies whether the background within the update region is to be erased when the update region is processed.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the function was successful or not.

function.name: NtUserLockWindowUpdate
function.description: This function locks the window update to the specified window and returns a boolean value indicating the success of the operation.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: This is a handle to the window that is to be locked for update.

function.return_type: BOOL, where TRUE indicates that the window was successfully locked for update and FALSE indicates failure.

function.name: fix_caret
function.description: This function adjusts the position of the caret in a window, based on the scrolling and other parameters. It also determines whether the caret needs to be moved along with scrolling.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window where the caret is located.

parameters.name: scroll_rect
parameters.description: Pointer to a RECT structure that specifies the scrolling rectangle.

parameters.name: dx
parameters.description: Specifies the amount of horizontal scrolling.

parameters.name: dy
parameters.description: Specifies the amount of vertical scrolling.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Specifies the scrolling flags.

parameters.name: move_caret
parameters.description: Pointer to a BOOL variable that indicates whether the caret needs to be moved.

parameters.name: new_caret_pos
parameters.description: Pointer to a POINT structure that receives the new caret position.

function.return_type: HWND. Returns the handle to the caret window if the caret needs to be updated during the scrolling, otherwise returns 0.

function.name: NtUserScrollWindowEx
function.description: This function scrolls the contents of the specified window's client area.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: A handle to the window to be scrolled.

parameters.name: dx
parameters.description: The amount of horizontal scrolling.

parameters.name: dy
parameters.description: The amount of vertical scrolling.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: A pointer to the RECT structure specifying the portion of the client area to be scrolled.

parameters.name: clip_rect
parameters.description: A pointer to the RECT structure specifying the clipping rectangle.

parameters.name: update_rgn
parameters.description: A handle to the region that is modified to represent the area to be updated.

parameters.name: update_rect
parameters.description: A pointer to the RECT structure receiving the bounding rectangle of the scroll region.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: The scrolling flags.

function.return_type: INT, represents the resulting region type. It can be NULLREGION if the region is empty, SIMPLEREGION if the region is a single rectangle, or COMPLEXREGION if the region is more than one rectangle.

function.name: NtUserPrintWindow
function.description: This function sends a message to the window to print itself, including its children, erasing the background, and printing owned windows and client windows. If the PW_CLIENTONLY flag is not set, it also prints non-client areas.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window that is to be printed.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Specifies the drawing options. It can be one or more of the following values: PW_CLIENTONLY.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE always indicating the successful execution of the function.
